docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The standard source book of Indian mathematics: numerals and the place-value system, arithmetic and algebra, with the rules and examples of the Hindu mathematicians in translation (Lahore, 1935–1938). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: History Of Hindu Mathematics A Source Book Part-iampii · Bibhutibhusan_datta · 1935, 621 scanned pages. Published 1935 and 1938; Bibhutibhusan Datta died 1958 and Avadhesh Narayan Singh 1954; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
